svg.text: Companion to docs/HARDWARE.md (pin tables) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (module map). Signal classes are colour-coded; see legend lower-right.

g.text: Star ground at PSU. One node per rail.
3.3 V logic — not 5 V tolerant. All 5 V signals must be level-shifted.
Internal pull-ups enabled on every input. Polled, not interrupt-driven.
Port B — board ID + rate sw
tool-length zero, triggers on stamp travel
one pole to GND, other to A.3
24 V (red) common to all sensor V+. Interface
to MCP via 10 kΩ pull-down to 3.3 V or opto.
480×320, landscape. Shared SPI bus, dedicated CS lines.
ILI9488 driver, all SPI pins configured.
MPG handwheel (5 V, 100 PPR) — via PC817 ×2
Opto-isolated: protects ESP32 from workshop ground bounce. Signals are inverted at the opto — MPG::SIGNALS_INVERTED = true.
Per channel: 330 Ω series in MPG-side LED loop;
10 kΩ pull-up from collector to 3V3 on ESP32 side.
Common to GND, throws pull MCP B4/B5/B6 LOW.
Plunge gated on Relay.isReady() — startup delay enforces spindle-at-speed.
Mains hot/neutral broken on hot leg by SSR; neutral passes through.
RC snubber across the SSR load contacts for inductive load suppression.
⚠ Mains wiring must be in an enclosed, earthed metal box. Hardware E-stop on the 24 V rail is mandatory from bench stage 5 onward.
• 698 RS bearing between motor shaft and screw — eliminates axial play
• Effective resolution: 4 mm / 1000 = 4 µm per microstep
• Soft limits enforced by MotorControl::moveToMm() before any step issued
• Hardware endstops back up soft limits — both must agree at start of homing
5 V (MPG, opto LED side, TFT backlight)
3.3 V (ESP32, MCP, opto Tx side, XPT2046)
Logic signal (3.3 V GPIO / MCP I/O)
